rulesBrief:
**Round 1 is one hour, split in two.** 15 MCQs get 15 minutes — that is 60 seconds each, so recognition beats derivation. Then 2 coding challenges get 45 minutes, roughly 22 minutes per problem including reading and debugging.

**Your team score is the average of every member's score.** One member at 5/15 drags a team of two 13s down to 10.3. There is no carrying anyone here — the cheapest marks on the table are the ones your weakest member is currently dropping.

**The Round 1 window is 8 hours wide (2:00 PM – 10:00 PM IST) but the test itself is 1 hour.** You choose when to start inside that window; once you start, the clock does not pause.

**Round 2 is individual, 45 minutes, one sitting, one attempt.** It is a written case study on brand visibility, marked on *analytical thinking, strategic approach, and the ability to derive actionable insights* — that phrasing is from the official brief, and it is effectively the rubric.

**Eligibility:** open to engineering students across all years and branches; teams of 2–3 from the same institute.

> Timings, quotes and dates on this page are taken from the official Unstop listing. Verify against Unstop before the round — the organisers can change them.
